original.target_description: Study 4, university undergraduates imagining victims or perpetrators in a workplace vignette; willingness to reconcile after an acceptance versus empowerment message; Role × Message interaction in the after condition (2 × 2 between-subjects ANOVA).

n.sample_role: Participants in the four experimental cells for the after-condition willingness-to-reconcile ANOVA; Table 5 N is consistent with the target F(1, 90).
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for this target analysis. Study 4 describes 94 participants; over 90% returned questionnaires, without a separately stated recruitment denominator.

replication.target_description: Reconciliation following acceptance versus empowerment messages among perpetrators versus victims. ML5 RP:P protocol; pooled replication meta-analysis.

n.sample_role: participants reported as N in the protocol column; analytic denominator and exclusions not independently documented here
n.location: p. 11, Table 3, corresponding study row, ML5 RP:P protocol N column

es.location: Table 4, Shnabel, N., & Nadler, A., RP:P protocol

p.location: Table 4, Shnabel, N., & Nadler, A., RP:P protocol

reported_success.quote: none of the 10 replications using the RP:P protocol yielded a statistically significant meta-analytic effect size (p < .05)

notes:
Replication ES and p are paired from Table 4. Table 3 supplies protocol N; some Table 3 point estimates/intervals differ slightly from Table 4. Narrative success is not inferred from p. Original full text unavailable after bounded primary/open-access acquisition.
Source follow-up: Published article title, authors, year and DOI match the assigned reference. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service. The supplied p. 14 locator corresponds to PDF p. 14 / printed p. 129. Target selected as the after-message Role × Message interaction because the neutral description specifies reconciliation following the messages. The same paragraph separately reports the Time × Message × Role interaction, F(1, 90) = 6.43, p < .05, η² = .07; that is a distinct test and is not combined with the extracted after-condition p value. Analytic N is supported by the Study 4 participant count, Table 5 N and matching ANOVA degrees of freedom; no N was calculated from the degrees of freedom. Replication and author success verdict were not examined, as required for an original-only target.
